rules.logic: ABIOC(AI-SOC-72 Valid-Account Reuse From Anomalous Endpoint Context) AND ABIOC(AI-SOC-72 Rapid Privilege Escalation After Valid-Account Compromise) AND XQL(AI-SOC-72 Exfiltration to Cloud Storage From Compromised Host) on the same agent_hostname and actor_effective_username within a 4320-second (72-minute) breakout window fuse into a single identity-to-exfiltration incident_id spanning the ENDPOINT and NDR planes.
